## About
Cluemaster Escape Rooms is an escape room in Gilbert, at the southwest corner of Guadalupe and Neeley. Every game is private, so you only play with the friends and family you bring.
Choose a classic prison break, a spooky small-town mystery, an extra challenging murder case or a space rescue that works for kids and adults too. Our rooms are a good fit for birthdays, team building, bachelor parties or just a night out in the East Valley.
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 724 reviews. Call or text us anytime with questions.

## Services
- Classic escape room: Cell Block is our classic room. You've been framed for a crime you didn't commit and have to break out of Alcatraz before it's too late.
- The mysterious murder of Madame Mesmerelda: Our extra challenging room. A famous fortune teller has been murdered in her shop, and you need to gather clues and identify the killer before they skip town.
- Search and Rescue: Great for kids and adults too. As new recruits with the Deep Space Rescue Service, you board the damaged CS Valkyrie and repair its systems to save the crew. One reviewer called it a great balance for kids and adults.
- Gift cards: Gift cards for any group size, valid for 1 year from date of purchase.

## FAQ
Q: Will we be playing with strangers?
A: No. Every escape room is private, so you only play with your own friends and family.

Q: How is pricing worked out?
A: Pricing for every game is based on the total number of players in your group. See our pricing page for your group's rate.

Q: Do you have a happy hour?
A: Yes. Every weekday, all games before 5:30 are 20% off. Use code HAPPYHOUR at checkout.

Q: Are you open on holidays?
A: We're closed Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
